items.title: FOCUS: Decoupling Expert Personas in LLMs to Enhance Domain Expert Capabilities
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can exhibit diverse personas, and activating expert personas has been shown to improve domain expertise and task accuracy. However, existing persona control methods often suffer from cross-domain coupling, which may lead to overly aggressive behavior in high-caution domains such as healthcare, or excessive conservatism in risk-sensitive domains such as financial trading. To address this issue, we propose FOCUS (\textbf{\underline{F}}ine-tuning with \textbf{\underline{O}}rthogonal \textbf{\underline{C}}ontrol for \textbf{\underline{U}}ncoupled persona\textbf{\underline{S}}). FOCUS first automatically extracts expert persona vectors from LLMs, then applies orthogonal decomposition to decouple domain-specific expert personas, and finally introduces an expert gating module to adaptively control persona activation according to task contexts. With a two-stage training strategy and a gated selection regularizer, the model learns to activate appropriate personas for both single-domain and cross-domain tasks. Experiments on financial, legal, medical, and cross-domain benchmarks show that FOCUS improves task accuracy and outperforms existing persona control methods. Our code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/openpersona-48F4}{this url}.

items.llm_tldr_en: FOCUS proposes orthogonal decomposition to decouple expert persona vectors in LLMs, enabling fine-grained control over domain expertise without cross-domain interference.
items.llm_tldr_cn: FOCUS提出正交分解方法对大模型中的专家人格向量进行解耦，从而实现对不同领域专家能力的精细干预与控制，避免跨领域耦合导致的过度激进或过度保守行为，显著提升了高风险领域任务的表现。
